examples.arabic: أهلاً وسهلاً بالطعام الجاهز طعمه كان رائع جداً
examples.english: Welcome to the ready food, its taste was very wonderful.
examples.transliteration: Ahlan wa sahlan bel-ṭa'am el-jahez ta'mo kan ra'e' jiddan.

examples.arabic: ههه عشان هيك الريحة لحالها بتشهي بس الطعمة الله اعلم
examples.english: Haha, that's why the smell alone is appetizing, but the taste, God knows!
examples.transliteration: Hahaha, 'ashan heik er-reeha la-halha bitshahhi bas et-ta'ma Allah a'lam.
